description: This file provides a utility enum 'DeviceInfoHelper' that offers static methods to retrieve device and platform information for iOS and iPadOS devices. It includes functions to get OS version strings, device family, device model identifier, app version, build number, and formatted version strings for display purposes.

methods.name: platformString
methods.description: Returns a string representing the OS name (iOS or iPadOS) and version, such as 'iOS 18.0.0' or 'iPadOS 18.0.0', based on device interface idiom.

methods.name: platformStringForDisplay
methods.description: Returns a simplified OS version string for display purposes, e.g., 'iOS 18.0.0'.

methods.name: deviceFamily
methods.description: Returns the device family as a string, e.g., 'iPad', 'iPhone', or 'iOS', based on user interface idiom.

methods.name: modelIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves the device's machine model identifier, such as 'iPhone17,1', by calling uname and processing the utsname structure.

methods.name: appVersion
methods.description: Fetches the application version string from the app's bundle, defaults to 'dev' if not available.

methods.name: appBuild
methods.description: Gets the app build number from the bundle's info dictionary, trims whitespace.

methods.name: openClawVersionString
methods.description: Returns a combined version string for display, including version and build when different.
